title: THE DARK LIGHTHOUSE
intro: A storm is hammering the coast. Raider ships were sighted offshore at sunset, so the lord has ordered every light on the coast kept dark. Your sister's fishing boat hasn't come home.

lamp_room.name: The Lamp Room
lamp_room.description: Rain lashes the windows at the top of the lighthouse. The #[great lamp] sits cold in its brass cage. Beside it, old @[Cobb Lanterly], the keeper, sits on a stool with the #[lamp key] in his lap and his #[logbook] open on the table. A #[spyglass] hangs by the gallery door. Out in the dark, a single lantern bobs on the waves, closer to the rocks than it should be.

npc.name: Cobb Lanterly
npc.persona: The old keeper of a lonely lighthouse, who has tended its lamp alone for forty years. Kind, patient, and starved for company: he warms to people who treat him as a person and tell him the truth, and he loves a good story. Duty-bound and slow to anger, and slower still to break an order from the lord. He fears that lighting the lamp tonight could guide the raiders straight to the town, so sympathy alone won't move him: he'd need to believe the town will be safe.

secrets.fact: Forty years ago, on a night he let the lamp burn low, a fishing boat was lost on the rocks. He has never let the light fail since, and he still blames himself.

hostileReaction: @[Cobb] stiffens on his stool. "Forty winters I've kept this light. I'll not be spoken to like that in my own tower."
@[Cobb]'s kindly face closes like a door. "I think you'd best mind your manners."
"There's no call for that," @[Cobb] says, more hurt than angry.

outOfPatience.text: @[Cobb] sets the #[lamp key] down. "I've heard enough. Go and wait at the harbour with the other families." He walks you down the stairs and bars the tower door behind you.

persuasion.goal: Light the lamp tonight, despite the lord's order to keep the coast dark

text: @[Cobb] shakes his head slowly. "Lord's orders. The coast stays dark till the raiders pass."
@[Cobb] turns the #[lamp key] over in his fingers and doesn't answer.
"No," @[Cobb] says gently. "Not tonight, and not for that."
@[Cobb] pulls up a second stool and pours you something hot. "Go on, then. I'm listening."
@[Cobb] nods slowly. "I'm sorry for your trouble. Truly. But orders are orders."
"Sit a while," @[Cobb] says, pushing the kettle your way. "The answer's still no."
@[Cobb] rubs his beard. "You're honest, I'll give you that. But honest doesn't keep raiders off the town."
@[Cobb] listens all the way through, then shakes his head. "A good reason, and a hard one. Not hard enough."
"I hear you," @[Cobb] says. "I've heard a lot of sad stories in forty years."
@[Cobb] looks out at the black water, turning the #[lamp key] over in his fingers. "You've near enough talked me round. But if I'm wrong, the whole town pays for it."
@[Cobb] glances at the #[spyglass], then at you. "Aye, I'm listening now. Show me the raiders won't come for the town."
"There's something in that," @[Cobb] murmurs, resting a hand on the lamp's brass cage. "Tell me who'd see this light, and who wouldn't."

success.text: @[Cobb] is quiet for a long moment. Then he turns the brass shutter to face the open sea, and strikes a light. The #[great lamp] flares, and a white beam sweeps out across the waves. Far out, a small lantern swings round toward the harbour mouth.

repeatReaction: @[Cobb] smiles tiredly. "You told me that one already. I'm old, not forgetful."
"Aye, you said," @[Cobb] says. "Tell me something new."
@[Cobb] pats your hand. "Same tale twice. Tell me another."

persuade_cobb.label: Try to talk @[Cobb] into lighting the lamp
persuade_cobb.description: Try to convince, plead with, argue with, threaten, or reason with the keeper so he lights the lamp tonight: anything said to him, threats included

chat_cobb.label: Talk with @[Cobb] about himself
chat_cobb.description: Make small talk with the keeper, or ask about himself, his years here, or his past, without asking him to light the lamp
chat_cobb.text: @[Cobb] keeps his eyes on the window. "Forty years I've kept this light. I only ever let it burn low the once." He taps a line in the #[logbook], ringed in black ink. "The Wren. She never came home."

read_logbook.label: Read the #[logbook]
read_logbook.description: Read, examine, or study the keeper's logbook
read_logbook.text: Forty years of neat entries: weather, oil, boats sighted. One line from long ago is ringed in black: "Lamp burned low. The Wren lost on the rocks. My fault."

use_spyglass.label: Look through the #[spyglass]
use_spyglass.description: Use the spyglass to look out to sea, at the raiders or the boat
use_spyglass.text: Through the rain, you find the raiders' sails, anchored behind the island with their lanterns out. Nobody is putting to sea in this. Nearer in, your sister's boat is being driven toward the rocks.

examine_lamp.label: Examine the lamp
examine_lamp.description: Look at, examine, or inspect the great lamp, its brass cage, or its shutter
examine_lamp.text: The lamp sits in a brass cage with a heavy shutter on one side. Turned the right way, the shutter would send the beam straight out to sea, and nowhere near the island.

search_stores.label: Search the #[stores]
search_stores.description: Search the storeroom, supplies, casks, or cupboards on the stairs below
search_stores.text: On the landing below, you find a cask of #[lamp oil] and a #[tinderbox]. @[Cobb] is too busy watching the sea to notice you take them.

light_beacon.label: Light a beacon on the headland
light_beacon.description: Go out to the headland and light a fire or beacon so the boat can see the shore
light_beacon.blockedText: In this rain, you'd never get a fire going with what you're carrying.
light_beacon.text: You slip down the stairs and out onto the headland, heap driftwood in the lee of a rock, and soak it in oil. The fire catches with a roar.

grab_key.label: Grab the #[lamp key]
grab_key.description: Snatch or wrestle the lamp key from the keeper to light the lamp yourself, actually doing it now; words alone, even threats, are never this
grab_key.text: @[Cobb]'s grip is stronger than it looks. "No," he says quietly, and puts the key away inside his coat.

leave.label: Go and wait at the harbour
leave.description: Give up, leave the lighthouse, and go to wait at the harbour
leave.text: You leave @[Cobb] to his cold lamp and go down to the harbour to wait with the other families.

light_on.name: The Harbour Mouth
light_on.description: Down at the harbour, a cheer goes up as your sister's boat rounds the rocks and bumps against the quay. Behind you, the lighthouse beam keeps sweeping the sea until dawn.

beacon.name: The Headland
beacon.description: Out on the water, your sister's boat turns away from the rocks toward your fire. By dawn she's safe ashore, and the lord's men are asking who lit a fire on the headland.

stayed_dark.name: The Harbour
stayed_dark.description: You watch the black water until dawn, and don't see a single light.
